desc:
Chewits Xtreme Sour Bites are intensely sour bonbons that deliver a proper mouth‑puckering hit with every chew, combining the sharp zing of lemon with the crisp tang of green apple. Each chewy piece packs an extreme burst of flavour that devoted sour‑sweet fans will relish.

Chewits · Bites
ingredients: sugar, glucose syrup, vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acids (lactic acid, citric acid), maltodextrin, acidity regulator (calcium lactate), natural flavouring, emulsifier (sucrose esters of fatty acids), colours (copper complexes of chlorophyllins, lutein). May contain MILK.
